method: LOBSTER 5.1.1 on QE all-PAW scf+nscf (ext basis Li 1s2s2p / P,S,Cl 3s3p3d / O 2s2p; nbnd 500; ecut 70/560; k 2 2 1), gabia A6000. Bader: bader -p all_atom on USPP valence rho cube (plot_num=0, 02_scf 60/480 conv 1e-8). Aggregated via analyze_per_bond_icohp.py (its printed '_provenance k444/AE plot_num=17' is template text - actual settings are these).

P-O.note: POS3 unit P30-O50 (top bond of the whole lattice)

Li-O.note: FIRST Li-O measurement in the family; per-bond covalency MODEST (< Li-S/Li-Cl)

Li-S_4d_freeS.note: free-S grips Li ~1.5x stronger per bond than PS4-S

P-O.note: SAME POS3 motif, same strength within 1.6% -> transferable O-anchor

bader_Li.note: Li+ carrier state UNCHANGED by O doping (same as B2O3 verdict)

comparison_vs_family._comp1_caveat: comp1_v3 bonds json (P +3.27, S -1.52) sits off the modelc/b2o3/lpsocl family (P +4.34-4.69) -> likely different Bader density source in that older run; do NOT mix comp1 Bader absolutes into this table without re-deriving.

headline.host_unchanged: All host bonds match modelc within ~3% -> single O substitution leaves the argyrodite bonding network intact
headline.pos3_anchor: P-O -8.41 eV = strongest bond in the lattice, identical to b2o3's POS3 (-8.55) -> the O anchor is motif-transferable
headline.li_trapping_mechanism: Li-O covalency is MODEST (-1.15/bond) while O carries the deepest charge (-1.93) -> the wang2022-style Li+ trapping near POS3 is ELECTROSTATIC (deep Coulomb well), not covalent gripping
headline.freeS: free-S (4d) binds Li at -2.51/bond vs PS4-S -1.67 -> per-bond the free-S sites are the strongest Li anchors among S
